name: Monthly County-Level Outcome Stratified Counts
description: Monthly admissions counts by county, stratified by age group, sex, dual eligibility and race

content.sex: Int64 : Sex category (0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female)
content.race: Int64 : Race category (0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native)
content.dual: Int64 : Dual eligibility status (1 = Dual eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid, 0 = Not dual eligible)
content.acute_bronchitis: Int64 : Number of acute bronchitis-related admissions
content.myocardial_infarction: Int64 : Number of myocardial infarction-related admissions
content.ischemic_stroke: Int64 : Number of ischemic stroke-related admissions
content.acute_kidney_injury: Int64 : Number of acute kidney injury-related admissions
content.respiratory_diseases: Int64 : Number of respiratory disease-related admissions
content.cvd: Int64 : Number of cardiovascular disease-related admissions
content.heart_failure: Int64 : Number of heart failure-related admissions
content.intestinal_infectious_diseases: Int64 : Number of intestinal infectious disease-related admissions
content.fluid_electrolyte_disorders: Int64 : Number of fluid and electrolyte disorder-related admissions
